description: Elemental composition of the 20 standard amino acids. 'free' is the free amino acid as it exists outside a chain (e.g. alanine); 'polymer' is the dehydrated in-chain residue (free minus one H2O, released per peptide bond formed with the next residue). The model samples polymerized protein (see metabolism_low_dim/model.py::sample_protein_cno_from_aa), so it uses 'polymer'. Molecular weights in each note use the same atomic masses as metabolism_low_dim/constants.py::ATOMIC_MASS. Amino-acid codes are single-letter IUPAC.
